reuse.why: Builds on the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper, the link.ts guards and the unlinkAccount field reset (extracted into clearBankLink) rather than writing a new path per provider.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is extracted and shared by unlinkAccount and the takeover, and the holder query is shared by assertBankAccountNotLinked and findBankAccountHolders; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The flag is handled once in the provider-agnostic guard in accounts/app.ts, the holder lookup lives in link.ts beside the existing assertion, and the type change is on the shared LinkAccountBaseParams.

scope.why: Only the guard, the extracted helpers, the param type and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, provider-independent, with comments on why the holder is cleared after the link and not via unlinkAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Deliberately does not call unlinkAccount (which would contact GoCardless) but shares its field reset through clearBankLink.
